Gus is in slot 1, which forces Cara into slot 3 (exactly one person between them) and Finn into slot 2 (Finn is immediately before Cara). Ben goes in slot 4, which is at least 3 after Gus. Dev then has to be in slot 8, since slot 7 would leave no free slot for Ann at least 3 away. That puts Ivo in slot 9, Ann in slot 5, Elif in slot 6 (after Cara) and Hana in slot 7 (at least 3 from Ben).

I checked all 14 constraints against this schedule and each one holds. I didn't test other placements of Gus, Ben and Dev, so I haven't shown the schedule is unique. It does satisfy every constraint.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Gus","2":"Finn","3":"Cara","4":"Ben","5":"Ann","6":"Elif","7":"Hana","8":"Dev","9":"Ivo"}
CONFIDENCE: 97
